Everything we add to the library, be it JavaScript option or a cssClass in the default templates is an API addition. Once it's there, we cannot remove it. And we have to document it.

Since the need was only expressed on one demo, I don't see the value of adding another API entry to hide the pagination, really no trying to dismiss the work you did. Just it doesn't seem to be that of a need that we need a new API entry.
